# Pinned FOCUS reference documents

These unmodified documents come from the FinOps Open Cost and Usage
Specification (FOCUS), version **1.4**, commit
`f1eeb30a78f7c141ef1237d589355296a2761c1c` in
[FOCUS_Spec](https://github.com/FinOps-Open-Cost-and-Usage-Spec/FOCUS_Spec/tree/f1eeb30a78f7c141ef1237d589355296a2761c1c).

Copyright (c) Joint Development Foundation Projects, LLC, FinOps Open Cost and
Usage Specification (FOCUS) Series and its contributors. Licensed under
**CC BY 4.0**; the upstream [license](specification/license.md) is included.
`specification/manifest.json` records source paths and SHA-256 digests.

`TestFOCUSOfficialColumnContract` independently derives required column names,
types, and non-null constraints from these documents. The test permits the
explicitly declared PaymentTerms source gap. Passing it verifies the scoped
projection; it does not assert full FOCUS conformance or certification.
